verdict.rationale: The evidence calls Jan an 'open-source' ChatGPT/Claude replacement, but it never names the license and never says whether commercial or enterprise use is free or needs a paid tier, subscription, or separate edition. A bare 'open-source' label does not tell a power-user the commercial-use terms, so this applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a power-user, I know whether commercial or enterprise use requires a paid license or subscription beyond the free community edition
